summary: The example's survey question becomes app_name; steps run rhaap:launch-job-template with the token, template name, inventory and extraVariables; output shows the job ID and status. Mapping: namespace hardcoded default, name lowercase with hyphens, title and description copied, labels lowercased tags, token auto-populated and hidden.
questions: How are survey answers passed from the portal to AAP?
How does the portal display job ID and status?

answer_card.title: rhaap:launch-job-template step
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
  steps:
    - id: launch-job
      name: Deploy Application
      action: rhaap:launch-job-template
      input:
        token: ${{ parameters.token }}
        values:
          template: Deploy Application          # AAP job template name
          inventory: ${{ parameters.inventory }} # Prompt on Launch
          extraVariables:                       # survey answers -> extra_vars
            app_name: ${{ parameters.app_name }}
  output:
    text:
      - title: Deploy Application template executed successfully
        content: |
          **Job ID:** ${{ steps['launch-job'].output.data.id }}
          **Job status:** ${{ steps['launch-job'].output.data.status }}
```
